title: Automated Override of Manual Failover/Quarantine
pattern: Allowing automated failback or auto-healing loops to unilaterally override manual quarantine states or administrative overrides.
why_bad: If an engineer manually drains or quarantines a node because of an active security compromise, memory leak, or data-corrupting bug, the auto-healing loop will interpret the node's responsiveness as "healthy" and automatically reintroduce it into rotation. This sabotages mitigation efforts [59].
detection: Look for background state reconciliation loops that can clear manually-set quarantine, drained, or isolated states without requiring explicit manual/administrative confirmation.
fix: Never permit automated systems to override manual administrative states (fail static or preserve manual overrides).
source: Heather Adkins et al., *Building Secure and Reliable Systems*, page 173 / passage [59].
